verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: Candidate A (39) is a multiple of 3 and 13, but it is not the largest such integer below 2000. The largest multiple of 39 below 2000 is 1989. Additionally, based on the IMO Shortlist 2004 problem C4, the condition that all diagonals of length 3k are balanced requires n to be a multiple of 9, which 39 is not.

verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: Candidate B (1989) is the largest multiple of 39 (lcm of 3 and 13) below 2000. Furthermore, 1989 is a multiple of 9, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a table where all diagonals of length 3k are balanced, as per the IMO Shortlist 2004.
